ModMetaData.name: Archinity - Pacing
ModMetaData.author: cjd72
ModMetaData.description:
Part of the Archinity suite.
World and timing adjustments for a long multi-era playthrough:
- Enlarges the Odyssey orbit layer so space has room for real factions. - Stops the Vanilla Races Expanded - Archon faction from ever raiding on the storyteller's initiative. They appear only when a quest summons them. - Removes the Transcendent gene from the archite injection random pool, reserving it for the Archinity quest line. - Fixes a broken cross-reference in More Realistic Research.
Pure XML patches. No assemblies, no Harmony, multiplayer-safe. Every patch is guarded so a missing mod is a no-op rather than an error.
